specs.Compatible Devices: iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, Smart iPhones
specs.Compatible Phone Models: iPhone 14/14 Pro/Pro Max, iPhone 13/13 Pro/Pro Max, iPhone 12, iPhone 11, iPhone X, iPhone XR, iPhone XS, iPhone 8, iPhone 7, iPhone 6, iPhone 6S, iPhone SE

features: FAST POWER: USB-C Power Delivery fast charging can charge the iPhone 13 up to 50% in 25 minutes—ideal for a quick boost before work or travel. Pair with a 20W or higher USB-C power adapter. Actual charging speed varies by device, battery condition and usage.

COMPATIBILITY YOU CAN CHECK: Compatible with iPhone 14/13/12 series, including available Plus, Mini, Pro and Pro Max models; 11/11 Pro/11 Pro Max, XS/XS Max/XR/X/8/8 Plus, and Lightning-equipped iPads. USB-C connects to your power source; Lightning connects to your device.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY USE: Enjoy a smooth, flexible cable with premium TPE coating that bends comfortably around your charging setup. Durable construction handles everyday use, while the flexible design makes it easy to coil, pack and carry wherever your day takes you.

CHARGE, SYNC & SAVE YOUR MEMORIES: Transfer photos, videos, music and important files at speeds up to 480 Mbps. Connect your Lightning device to a compatible USB-C computer for convenient syncing and backups—one practical cable for both charging and data transfer.

YOUR EVERYDAY CHARGING COMPANION: From bedside charging to office top-ups and road trips, keep power within reach. Works with compatible USB-C wall adapters, power banks and car chargers. Easy to store in your bag for convenient charging at home, work or on the move.
